svg.title: Three hundred of 331 local authorities change sides across sources
svg.desc: A unit chart shows 300 local authorities above a fitted rate in at least one source and below it in another.
svg.text: DATA STORY · ACT II · 331 LOCAL AUTHORITIES

text.tspan: SIT ABOVE A FITTED RATE IN
The pair is memorable. The full pattern
shows it is not an edge case.

svg.text: The 91% describes cross-source position relative to fitted rates—not the percentage of people represented.
Source numerators and observation dates differ; fitted rates are source specific.
